meta.promptText: Which vitamin C serum should I buy for dark spots and dull skin in India?

response.text:
When choosing a Vitamin C serum for dark spots and dull skin in India, look for a stable formulation between **10% to 15% concentration**.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/skin-care/best-vitamin-c-serum-for-indian-skin-what-actually-works#:~:text=The%20best%20vitamin%20C%20serum,dark%20spots%20and%20evening%20tone.) Higher percentages (like 20%+) can sometimes cause irritation on melanin-rich skin, which can actually lead to more dark spots.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/skin-care/best-vitamin-c-serum-for-indian-skin-what-actually-works#:~:text=Sensitive%20skin%3A%20start%20at%2010,with%20other%20pigment-fading%20actives.)

Popular and effective options available in India include:

* **The Derma Co 10% Vitamin C Face Serum:** Contains niacinamide and hyaluronic acid; great for oily or acne-prone skin dealing with post-acne marks.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/skin-care/best-vitamin-c-serum-for-indian-skin-what-actually-works#:~:text=Rating%3A%204.4%E2%98%85,with%20Niacinamide%20%26%20Hyaluronic%20Acid%20-%2030ml)
* **Deconstruct 10% Vitamin C Serum:** Uses liposomal technology with 0.5% ferulic acid for enhanced stability, making it effective for fading dullness and pigmentation.[thedeconstruct.in](https://thedeconstruct.in/products/vitamin-c-and-ferulic-acid-serum#:~:text=10%25%20Liposomal%20Vitamin%20C%20Helps,Bestseller)
* **Dr. Sheth’s Ceramide & 10% Vitamin C Ampoule Serum:** Combines Vitamin C with ceramides to support the skin barrier while targeting dark spots, which helps prevent irritation.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/skin-care/best-vitamin-c-serum-for-indian-skin-what-actually-works#:~:text=Why%20It%20Works%3A%2010%25%20is,Dr.)
* **Minimalist 10% or 16% Vitamin C Face Serum:** A fragrance-free, transparent formulation known for stability and effective brightening.

---

### Tips for Best Results

* **Start Slow:** If you are new to actives, use the serum every other morning for the first week to let your skin adjust.[www.drsheths.com](https://www.drsheths.com/blogs/skin-care/best-vitamin-c-serum-for-indian-skin-what-actually-works#:~:text=Sensitive%20skin%3A%20start%20at%2010,with%20other%20pigment-fading%20actives.)
* **Always Use Sunscreen:** Vitamin C helps fade dark spots, but UV rays create them faster.[www.minskinn.com](https://www.minskinn.com/blogs/minskinn-blogs/best-vitamin-c-serum-india#:~:text=Apply%20Dewy%20Glass%20Look%20Toner,Sun%20Spots%20and%20Freckles) Always follow up with a broad-spectrum SPF 30 or higher during the day.
* **Check the Color:** Pure Vitamin C can oxidize over time.[discoverpilgrim.com](https://discoverpilgrim.com/blogs/discover-beauty-secrets/best-vitamin-c-serum-in-india-dermatologist-guide#:~:text=Pure%20L-ascorbic%20acid%20is,suit%20sensitive%20or%20beginner%20skin.) If your serum turns a dark amber or brown, it has lost its potency and should be replaced.[www.minskinn.com](https://www.minskinn.com/blogs/minskinn-blogs/best-vitamin-c-serum-india#:~:text=Using%20oxidised%20serum%20%E2%80%94%20If%20your,morning%20and%20retinol%20at%20night)
